component.name: @APP_DISPLAY_NAME@
component.summary: Visual stabilization overlay for Linux desktop sessions

description.p: GazeAnchor provides non-invasive visual anchors such as edge overlays, a center crosshair, and a floating clock to reduce motion sickness in 3D games.
Feature availability depends on the current Linux desktop session. KDE Plasma Wayland and X11 are the primary targets, while other Wayland compositors may run in a degraded mode.
